risks.proof: Photos of the back, bottom, and sides of the console, showing all ports, vents, and any damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with major defects

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit
risks.proof: Clear photo of the model number and serial number on the console, ideally from the bottom or back.

risks.risk: Games mentioned (offline/online) may not be included or may be pirated
risks.proof: Photo of the console's game library or a screenshot of the console's dashboard showing installed games.
